output_list.reason: The 'generateTokens' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is that '_amount' is not checked to ensure it does not overflow the 'balanceOf[owner]' variable, allowing attackers to mint an arbitrary amount of tokens.
The 'generateTokens' function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The function allows the controller to mint arbitrary amount of tokens, causing token devaluation.

The 'freeze' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is that '_value' is not checked to ensure it does not overflow the 'balanceOf[_user]' variable, allowing attackers to freeze an arbitrary amount of tokens.

The 'unFreeze' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is that '_end' is not checked to ensure it does not overflow the 'uint8' type, allowing attackers to unfreeze an arbitrary amount of tokens.

The 'changeAirdropTotalQty' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is that '_airdropTotalQty' is not checked to ensure it does not overflow the 'balanceOf[owner]' variable, allowing attackers to set the total airdrop quantity to a very large value.
